review_backend: Codex agent read-only results review; no external reviewer MCP was available

protocol.score_direction: fixed higher vs error; no label-based flipping/normalization
protocol.labels_stage: evaluation only; oracle boundaries not detector inputs
protocol.scope: coarse observer replay dependence, not ownership/routing/continuous-span detector

interpretation_limits: Each group AUROC/AUPRC is source-balanced; token-weighted group-AUROC is an aggregation of group estimates, not a pooled AUROC.
Post-first raw error prevalence is not the baseline for a source-balanced AUPRC and must not be compared as though it were.
bootstrap_replicates is zero; no confidence intervals or significance claims are available.
The analysis is observer replay sensitivity after the first annotation; it is not a detector, source owner, routing, continuous-span, or original-generator causal result.
